'''Zelaba''' was an object<ref name="FJ">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> in the [[Outer Jalor sector/Legends|Outer Jalor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[44 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] had been on many battlefields and remembered the [[Death/Legends|death]] screams she had heard from [[Anthus]] to Zelaba.<ref name="FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The object Zelaba was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', which was written by [[Troy Denning]]<ref name="FJ" /> and released in [[2012]].<ref name="ERC" /> Later, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online appendix]] to the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Zelaba system/Legends|Zelaba star system]] and the object itself in grid square I-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
